title: Foundry commercial terms: wafer pricing, LTAs and capacity prepayments
why_it_matters: The fabless-to-foundry payment is the largest design-to-manufacturing money flow; pricing basis and risk-sharing terms were not established in discovery.
questions: How are foundry wafers priced by node and what drives price changes?
What prepayment, capacity-reservation and shortfall terms are used, and how large are they (contract liabilities)?
How were LTAs renegotiated in 2023-2024?
primary_sources: TSMC, UMC, GlobalFoundries, SMIC 20-F/annual report notes on contract liabilities and temporary receipts

title: Memory business model and price cycle
why_it_matters: Memory is the most cyclical segment (2023 fall ~29-37%, 2025 rise ~35%); contract vs spot pricing and inventory behaviour drive industry cyclicality.
questions: How are DRAM/NAND priced (contract vs spot) and how often renegotiated?
How do inventory write-downs and utilisation cuts transmit the cycle to profits and capex?
What is HBM's pricing and contracting model?
primary_sources: Micron, SK hynix, Samsung, Kioxia annual reports

title: Distribution channel economics
why_it_matters: Distributors hold inventory and are protected by suppliers; mechanics (ship-and-debit, price protection, stock rotation) and margins not established.
questions: What share of chip sales goes through distributors by segment?
How do price protection, ship-and-debit and stock rotation work and who bears the cost?
What are distributor gross/operating margins on semiconductors?
primary_sources: Avnet, Arrow, WPG, WT Microelectronics 10-K/annual reports
Chipmaker 10-K revenue recognition notes (TI, Microchip, ADI, NXP)

title: Government money flows into semiconductors by country
why_it_matters: Subsidies, tax credits and state equity now co-fund fabs; only US and EU/Germany flows were captured in discovery.
questions: What grants, loans, tax credits and equity stakes have Japan, Korea, China (Big Fund), Taiwan, India (ISM) and EU members given, to whom?
How are awards disbursed and clawed back?
How material are incentives relative to recipients' capex?
primary_sources: METI, MOTIE, MIIT/Big Fund disclosures, India Semiconductor Mission, EU Chips Act state-aid decisions
entities: China National IC Industry Investment Fund

title: Equipment makers' commercial model: systems, services, down payments
why_it_matters: Equipment is a US$135bn annual flow; down-payment practice, service contracts and system pricing not established.
questions: Do fabs pay down payments on tools (e.g. EUV) and how large?
How are service contracts and upgrades priced?
How concentrated is equipment demand by customer and region?
primary_sources: ASML, Applied Materials, Lam Research, Tokyo Electron, KLA annual reports (contract liabilities notes)

title: Packaging and test value pool, incl. advanced packaging
why_it_matters: OSAT margins are low (14-24% in sampled firms) but advanced packaging is growing and partly done by foundries; pricing basis unknown.
questions: How are OSAT services priced?
How much advanced packaging revenue is captured by foundries versus OSATs?
What capex does advanced packaging require?
primary_sources: ASE, Amkor, JCET annual reports; TSMC reporting on advanced packaging

title: Cross-model financial benchmark (margins, capex, R&D) on consistent periods
why_it_matters: Discovery gathered single-company figures across mismatched fiscal years; a consistent benchmark by business model is needed before generalising.
questions: For 3-5 firms per business model, what are gross margin, capex/revenue and R&D/revenue for the same periods across a full cycle (e.g. 2019-2025)?

title: Design-IP and patent-licensing royalty economics
why_it_matters: Royalty flows (Arm per chip, Qualcomm per device) connect chip value to end devices; rates and mechanics only partly evidenced.
questions: How are royalty rates set and reported (in arrears, per chip, % of ASP)?
How concentrated are licensees?
How do licensing disputes affect flows?
primary_sources: Arm and Qualcomm 10-K/annual reports; Rambus, CEVA, Imagination filings
